g.text: 1 m = 8 px • X → −Z ↑ • source geometry • Y = world height (metres) • killY -12 m
Green → blue → violet = higher surfaces; labels show max Y. Dashed purple = motion. Camera line is not a walking route.
CP checkpoint ◆ crystal ○ bonus entrance ■ crates × enemy Blue = rails Rust = blocking bounds
Draw above the map. Keep its title and A–D reference crosses for precise annotation return.
